comparison_type: official-documentation review; no competitor systems executed

products.name: Mem0
documented_capabilities: Published memory evaluation documentation and benchmark tooling
LoCoMo/LongMemEval/BEAM benchmark suite, retrieval evidence UI, logs and run comparison
products.our_position: An audit workflow that links reviewed source facts, behavioural failures, controlled repairs and paired retests. Do not claim Mem0 has no evaluation or audit trail.

products.name: Zep
documented_capabilities: Temporal context graph and agent context retrieval
Custom evaluation dataset and retrieval-response evaluation workflow
products.our_position: Expose a local, inspectable four-dimension Auditor workflow and controlled before/after evidence. Custom evaluation alone is not a unique advantage over Zep.

products.name: LongMemEval
documented_capabilities: Standardised evaluation of long-term interactive memory
Knowledge updates, temporal reasoning and other memory abilities
products.our_position: Audit a specific user's authorised history and test targeted repairs; use official benchmark protocols separately for external validity.

products.name: LangSmith
documented_capabilities: Offline/online evaluation, datasets and multiple evaluator types
products.our_position: Evaluate the incremental value of human-confirmed personal-history probes and controlled diagnosis/repair studies; do not claim this existing capability is unique.

products.name: Graphiti
documented_capabilities: Temporal knowledge graph, provenance and hybrid retrieval for agent memory
products.our_position: Evaluate the incremental value of human-confirmed personal-history probes and controlled diagnosis/repair studies; do not claim this existing capability is unique.

products.name: Ragas
products.our_position: Evaluate the incremental value of human-confirmed personal-history probes and controlled diagnosis/repair studies; do not claim this existing capability is unique.

current_project_advantages_to_test: Traceability from source messages to diagnosed failure and final supplied memory
Same-model paired retests with frozen question identities
Integrated failure inspection and regression comparison
Explicit separation of AI pre-review from human validation
limitations: The current connector executes the controlled built-in memory system, not actual Mem0/Zep installations
Local benchmark-compatible simulations are not official benchmark scores
The synthetic pilot cannot establish general commercial superiority
Actual improvements must be measured; favourable scores are not guaranteed
